mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and deceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate below 0.2% monthly) signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.2%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized rate > 2.0%), the economy is in an expansionary phase that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO rising for three consecutive months) indicates robust manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening residential sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue prospects, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 1200 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized rate > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain restrictive monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO falling below 100 for two consecutive months) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months.
